verdict.rationale: Fly.io docs mention Machines 'boot in under a second, run close to your users' (fly-io-docs-14) and maintain consistent primitives at scale (fly-io-docs-15), implying latency-focused edge deployment, but there's no evidence of an automatic placement mechanism that specifically colocates compute near backend data sources (e.g., databases) rather than just end users. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic compute-to-data proximity logic, region-aware scheduling tied to data location, and independent verification that this reduces data-access latency in practice.
